title: Exercise angina–peak-heart-rate coupling provides no robust incremental CAD prediction across two hospital cohorts
abstract: A fixed exercise-angina by peak-heart-rate interaction was tested beyond additive conventional measures from Cleveland (303 records) to Hungary (261 complete records). Target Brier improved by only0.00002608, with conditional95% interval excluding zero but two-sample refit interval spanning−0.00934 to+0.01162. Source cross-validation worsened, and linear/regularization sensitivities reversed gains. This is not evidence of a clinically useful biomarker or biological equivalence. Historical target outcome reuse limits confirmation.
